{{greeting}}

Thanks for giving bingd a shot. I built it because the usual 1–5 star
ratings never really felt like they captured the experience of watching
a good movie or TV show.

Here are a few of my favorite ways to use the app:

Post-watch Ranking: Instead of picking a number, compare titles
head-to-head and bingd builds your ranked list. That list keeps evolving
as you discover new favorites (Avengers: Doomsday anyone?).

Pre-vetted Watchlist: My favorite part of the feed is not just seeing
what my friends are watching. It's putting those titles in my watchlist
and then teasing them about their taste later (The Emoji Movie,
really?).

Smooth Planning: The Group Picks feature (under For you) generates
recommendations across multiple bingd users when you're struggling to
find a pick before the popcorn runs out. It's a favorite for movie clubs
and couples!

If you want to suggest a new feature, find something confusing, or love
the app and just want to say hi, you can hit reply to this email. It
comes straight to me.

bingd is more fun with friends, so here's your invite link
(https://bingd.app/i/{{inviteToken}}). And if you want to see what I'm
watching, follow me on bingd (https://bingd.app/u/saisurajkan).

Happy binging,
Suraj
